rows.reply: In the TradePro demo, you can find the Profile card by opening the Onboarding panel and selecting the Profile card to begin the KYC profile (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 1).
According to the TradePro Demo Support fixture (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 1), the demo KYC profile support reference is CEDAR-KYC.

To resume an existing identity verification session in the TradePro demo, select the Continue identity button on the Identity card (Source: TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, Page 1). Do not create a new session simply because you signed out.
In the TradePro demo, you can find the Deposit card by opening the Funds panel. (Source: TradePro Demo Support, page 2)

According to the TradePro Demo Support documentation (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 2), the demo deposit help reference is MARIGOLD-D1, which identifies the deposit support article.
To locate a demo deposit receipt in the TradePro demo environment, open Activity, select the deposit entry, and choose Receipt (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 2).

In the TradePro demo, you can find the Withdrawal card by opening the Funds panel. Selecting the Withdrawal card provides access to withdrawal guidance (reference WILLOW-W2). To track demo withdrawals, open Activity, select Withdrawals, and check the status badge beside the entry (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 3).

According to the TradePro Demo Support documentation (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 3), the demo withdrawal help reference is WILLOW-W2, which identifies the withdrawal support article.

According to the TradePro Demo Support documentation (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 4), the demo transfer review screen labels the sending account as **Source** and the receiving account as **Destination**.
According to the TradePro Demo Support documentation, the demo transfer help reference is BIRCH-T3 (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 4).

Verified policy information regarding exact withdrawal fees in the TradePro demo is not available. No real fees, limits, or eligibility policies are stated in the demo support documentation (TradePro Demo Support - Development Fixture, page 3).
